title: Verdant Ruins: The Historian's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the unaltered historical account; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
